# fundament_clusters (Data Source)

Fetches the list of clusters for the current organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fundament_clusters" "all" {}

output "cluster_names" {
  value = [for c in data.fundament_clusters.all.clusters : c.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `clusters` (Attributes List) List of clusters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))
- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source.

<a id="nestedatt--clusters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clusters`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the cluster.
- `name` (String) The name of the cluster.
- `region` (String) The region where the cluster is deployed.
- `status` (String) The status of the cluster (e.g., running, provisioning, stopped).
